metadata.description: Android installer app that runs the real RuneLite client on Samsung Tab S10 Ultra via Termux + proot-distro
metadata.session_notes: Session 72: Executed Slices 1-3 of direct-surface 120fps plan. Named the hot X server PutImage path (exaPutImage @ exa_accel.c:252) via dladdr, then discovered Xlorie's EXA driver had no UploadToScreen callback — every PutImage fell through to fbPutImage software. Implemented lorieUploadToScreen → 99.6% accel. damage-redraw rate 44-51 → 60-66 FPS. Prior 'VirGL is the ceiling' conclusion (session 70) REFUTED: VirGL was never the bottleneck; the X server was CPU-copying everything. Not at 120 FPS gate yet.

active_blockers.description: Session 72 measurably improved damage rate (44-51 → 60-66 FPS) via lorieUploadToScreen, but still far below the 120 FPS gate. Per-PutImage-strip overhead (~1500 calls/sec, 84 per frame) is now the visible bottleneck.

resolved_blockers.description: DamageTraceV2 proved the hot steady-state path is PutImage on WINDOW with backend=other, not fbPutImage or miPutImage.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 72: extended DamageTraceV2 with dladdr offset logging and routed through __android_log_print. addr2line resolved the unknown backend to `exaPutImage` @ xserver/exa/exa_accel.c:252, and exaComposite @ xserver/exa/exa_render.c:887. Both sit inside the EXA acceleration framework. Follow-on Slice 3 fix (lorieUploadToScreen) made the path 99.6% accelerated.

resolved_blockers.description: Session 70 concluded VirGL vtest socket serialization was the structural FPS ceiling (17-28ms inter-frame).
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 72 REFUTED this. VirGL throughput was never the bottleneck — the X server was software-copying every PutImage via ExaCheckPutImage → fbPutImage because lorieExa had no UploadToScreen callback. After implementing lorieUploadToScreen, accel went from 0% to 99.6% and FPS moved up 25-30%. Further FPS work targets per-strip overhead and presentation, not VirGL throughput.

resolved_blockers.description: All clean architecture changes need verification on Samsung Tab S10 Ultra.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 69: Full end-to-end verification on R52X90378YB. Boot → setup → auth → launch → rendering all pass. All logging layers verified.

resolved_blockers.description: Zero tests, god classes >500 LoC, tight Android coupling, global mutable singletons, no CI.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 64-65: 180 tests, domain layer with zero Android imports, DI container (7 modules), all god classes ≤200 LoC, singletons eliminated, CoroutineDispatcher injected everywhere, CI pipeline active.

resolved_blockers.description: The 120 FPS investigation initially rebuilt and reinstalled only third_party/termux-x11-upstream :app, while the validated internal-hybrid path was actually using libXlorie.so packaged inside com.runelitetablet.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Session 62: Added XlorieIdentity logs, proved runtime identity, switched correct build/install loop.

completed_phases.notes: Sessions 66-69: DebugLogServer with HTML/WebSocket viewer, 11 new Logger methods, 30+ files instrumented, native C instrumented. 210 tests. 127/128 spec items PASS. Device-verified on R52X90378YB.

Sessions 63-65: Wrote spec (115 items), executed all implementable items. 180 tests, domain layer, DI container, god class decomposition, singleton elimination, dispatcher injection, CI pipeline. Device-verified session 69.
Session 62: Corrected build target, proved runtime identity, validated hot path.
